environment: Disposable JSON companies; authenticated API security/browser suites; no provider sends

criteria.requirement: startup opens Dashboard and primary navigation remains usable at a narrow mobile viewport.
“Tasks due today” contains only today's active tasks, excluding future, completed and archived work.
pipeline premium preserves decimal amounts and excludes closed opportunities from open-pipeline value; date-labelled KPIs use their stated period.
unauthenticated access and missing-CSRF mutations fail; tenant and read-only boundaries hold, including direct record requests.
profile editing changes the signed-in user's identity/profile, not another team member selected by a shared company setting.
deactivation revokes access immediately and a user cannot become their own manager or form a reporting cycle.
a valid signed synthetic webhook creates one attributed lead; replay does not create duplicates and invalid signatures fail.
an ingested lead has a linked canonical first task and contact/organization relationships, matching direct-entry behavior.
a real provider sandbox completes authorization, asset selection, subscription, delivery, token renewal and disconnect without manual database edits.

evidence.message: No authorized provider sandbox/asset and callback subscription supplied for this audit

criteria.requirement: mapped import accepts valid rows, reports invalid rows and preserves a retrievable import result/error file.
imported leads receive the same canonical next-action/task relationship as directly entered leads.
retrying a committed batch does not duplicate records; rollback preserves records subsequently edited/converted or reports a conflict.
preview does not alter rotation state; supported rule creation, editing and ordering are retrievable.
bulk lead reassignment propagates to open tasks, appointments and notification ownership with conflict protection.
direct-entry, imported and webhook leads apply the same enabled routing rules when no explicit owner is supplied.
authenticated browser creation and stage change persist; conversion can be reached from the lead row.
canonical task rename/date/completion updates the lead; failed conflicting changes roll back.
invalid stages and Lost without a reason are rejected; only configured valid stages are accepted.
an independent deal can be created, edited and linked to its customer or lead through supported API/UI paths.
converting a lead with an existing deal sets that deal to Won and links the converted customer, without creating a second deal.
expected close date appears once in Calendar and opens the deal context.
conversion creates a customer and linked draft policy, keeps source history, and rejects/reuses a repeated conversion without duplicating records.
choosing a different organization during conversion produces a valid organization ID and consistent customer/contact/policy relationships.
already scheduled lead appointments and follow-ups remain visible under the converted customer.
multiple policies and contacts belong to one customer and are included in its 360° response.
profile edits show consistently in linked active policy/customer labels without changing IDs or historical snapshots.
360° includes related appointments, tasks, notes, communications, documents and servicing, including policy-linked items.
organization creation and editing persist and are audited.
renaming an organization updates active display labels through stable IDs across customers, contacts and policies.
invalid relationship IDs are rejected rather than saved as disconnected masters.
multiple contacts can be created and edited without overwriting each other.
editing a lead's primary contact details preserves a secondary contact's name and details.
nonexistent customer/organization references cannot be saved to contacts.
task creation rejects invalid dates and missing titles; edits synchronize canonical related work.
rejected browser saves show the server error and preserve the open form; archived tasks are excluded from active lists.
a task linked to a customer opens customer context rather than a lead drawer.
appointment and linked task appear once in Calendar; edits synchronize both ways; booking/follow-up works in the authenticated browser.
conflict checks apply through task edits and Calendar moves, including cross-midnight appointments.
timezone validation rejects invalid zones; DST nonexistent/ambiguous local times require explicit handling rather than silent reinterpretation.
upcoming work creates a deduplicated notification; completed/deleted work resolves alerts and reassignment updates the owner.
renewal/service/task/appointment reassignment and completion consistently update their own related alerts.

evidence.message: True is not false : Closed renewal retains an unread overdue alert

criteria.requirement: a restarted durable worker processes due work once across concurrent workers; escalation reaches the configured manager after the configured delay.
notes persist with their relationship and remain archived when their lead is deleted.
a user can correct a note through a supported edit operation with an audit record.
note authorship uses the authenticated actor, not a caller-supplied impersonation label.
quote selection rejects an offer belonging to another renewal/opportunity and rejects an expired offer.
quotation validity uses one field contract across create/edit and Calendar projection.
new-business quotes can attach to an open deal before any existing policy renewal; selected terms/version remain traceable in issuance.
backend calculates decimal premium and tax consistently; negative values and invalid/reversed term dates are rejected.
issuance requires insurer, number, term and real linked checklist evidence; another update endpoint cannot bypass issuance gates.
new policies belong to a valid customer; policy modifications are audited and visible in customer history.
generation excludes drafts/cancelled policies and does not create two active renewals for the same policy term.
completing the same renewal twice creates at most one successor policy, preserving predecessor links and customer continuity.
loss/lapse requires a reason and completion requires a selected quote plus valid issuance evidence.
a service request cannot use a policy belonging to a different customer.
endorsement completion synchronizes its servicing workflow; linked service work is visible in 360°/Calendar and alerts.

criteria.requirement: completing a service request requires an outcome/evidence appropriate to the request rather than losing unresolved work.
missing provider configuration does not claim successful delivery; SMS is rejected.
delivered/read states do not regress from older callbacks; a replay cannot duplicate a delivery event or resend an already sent message.
real sandbox Email and WhatsApp delivery, inbound replies, bounce/failure, opt-out and retry are verified with provider evidence.

evidence.message: No authorized sandbox recipient/provider environment; no external messages sent

criteria.requirement: reusable templates can be created, edited, archived and restored; archive is distinct from sending.
customer-level opt-out is honored for customer-linked messages and after lead conversion, not only on the original lead ID.
invalid template references/unresolved variables and unapproved WhatsApp templates cannot silently become queued outbound messages.
supported files are versioned and readable; unsupported extensions/content mismatch are rejected.
nonexistent/wrong-company record references are rejected before storage, and failed metadata saves do not leave untracked objects.

evidence.message: 200 not found in {404, 422} : Document upload accepted a nonexistent parent

criteria.requirement: production private-object access, malware scanning and object restoration are verified against the deployed services.

evidence.message: Requires disposable production-equivalent object storage and malware scanner

criteria.requirement: search returns stable typed IDs and pagination boundaries work on leads.
saved views are user-owned, persist criteria and do not expose another user's private view.
search can find tasks/service work as well as customer masters; lists remain usable at realistic volume with bounded responses.

evidence.message: False is not true : Global search cannot find action tasks

criteria.requirement: win rate is Won / (Won + Lost); conversion is converted leads / eligible leads, clearly labelled with period and population.

evidence.message: 100.0 != 50 : Labelled conversion metric uses closed-only win-rate denominator

criteria.requirement: open-work counts exclude completed/archived tasks and aggregate owners consistently with the work queue.
reports support a date cohort/period and reconcile to underlying eligible records; retained premium and renewal retention have explicit denominators.
invalid timezone/reminder values are rejected; valid settings are retrievable.
configured lead stages are accepted by transition validation and included in pipeline/reporting, or unsupported configuration is rejected explicitly.

evidence.message: 422 != 200 : Settings accepted a stage the transition engine rejects

criteria.requirement: product and insurer choices drive relevant forms and validation consistently; existing records survive configuration changes.
merge relinks operational references and refuses implicit merging of distinct converted customers.
archive/restore does not reopen previously archived tasks; lead deletion retains archived notes.
deleting a lead removes dependent servicing/endorsement/calendar relationships while retaining independent shared records; no dangling IDs remain.

evidence.message: True is not false : Cascade left servicing records pointing at deleted policy/customer

criteria.requirement: core mutations produce actor/company-labelled audit events and chain verification detects tampering.
integration replay, migration, assignment and archive operations are audited; no mutating route is silently exempt.
rejected role access cannot modify another team member's profile or administrative credentials through alternate endpoints.
concurrent local writers cannot silently overwrite each other; corrupt storage is not replaced with demo data; logical restore keeps a safety copy.
production PostgreSQL migration, constraints, concurrent writes, worker restarts and database-plus-object recovery are rehearsed with measured RPO/RTO.

evidence.message: Requires designated disposable PostgreSQL/object-store environment and measured restore drill

criteria.requirement: authenticated screens load without JavaScript/request failures, mobile layouts avoid horizontal overflow, and full keyboard/screen-reader and load testing are completed.
